blueprint_concepts: Position of points wrt a line
Distance of a point from a line, distance between parallel lines

concept_use.Position of points wrt a line: The side of the line not containing the origin is found from the sign of 3x + 4y - 12 at the origin.
concept_use.Distance of a point from a line, distanc: The distance (3x + 4y - 12)/5 < 10 bounds the strip, giving 3x + 4y < 62.

english: Let $S$ be the set of all points $(x,y)$, where $x$ and $y$ are positive integers, that lie on the side of the line $3x+4y=12$ not containing the origin and whose distance from this line is less than $10$. Then the number of elements of $S$ is ______.
hindi: माना $S$ उन सभी बिन्दुओं $(x,y)$ का समुच्चय है, जहाँ $x$ तथा $y$ धनात्मक पूर्णांक हैं, जो रेखा $3x+4y=12$ के उस ओर स्थित हैं जिस ओर मूल बिन्दु नहीं है, तथा जिनकी इस रेखा से दूरी $10$ से कम है। तब $S$ के अवयवों की संख्या ______ है।
solution: At the origin $3x+4y-12<0$, so the other side is $3x+4y>12$; distance $\dfrac{3x+4y-12}{5}<10\Rightarrow3x+4y<62$
solution_full: Let $f(x,y)=3x+4y-12$. At the origin $f=-12<0$, so the side not containing the origin is $f>0$, i.e. $3x+4y>12$.
For such a point the distance from the line is $\dfrac{3x+4y-12}{5}$, and it is less than $10$ when $3x+4y<62$.
So we count positive integers $x,y$ with $13\le3x+4y\le61$.
Lower bound: $y\ge1$, and also $4y\ge13-3x$, which matters only for $x=1$ ($y\ge3$) and $x=2$ ($y\ge2$).
originality_note: New: a lattice-point count in a strip defined by a side condition and a distance bound from the same line (way 5: position of points + distance from a line). Closest known: 'number of integer points inside a triangle'. Different because: the region is a strip on the far side of the line cut by the quadrant, so the side test and the distance inequality must both be translated before counting.
stem_review: Read as a student: every point, line, curve and symbol is introduced before use, every condition is stated, each sentence has one reading; the answer was recomputed independently with sympy/mpmath (and a numerical brute-force check), is unique and equals the Answer Plan. 'Positive integers' and 'less than 10' (strict) fix the count; checked by brute force (137). Changed: No change.
key_step: Translating 'side not containing the origin' and 'distance < 10' into 12 < 3x + 4y < 62, then counting row by row.
justification: Two standard translations followed by a careful but routine count with no options; some precision risk. Placed at L2 with 2021-P2-Q17 (L1) as the nearest counting anchor plus the extra translation and length of the count.
